senses.gloss:
अर्तगल अर्त-गल, अस्, m., N. of a plant,
Barleria cærulea Roxb.

अर्तन अर्तन, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ऋत्), blaming,
reviling; (अम्), n. censure, approach, abuse.

आर्तना आर्तना, f. (according to Sāy. de-
rived fr. आर्त above), Ved. a destructive combat;
(as an adj. ?) uncultivated, wild ground (? connected
with आर, अरण, अरण्य, &c.).

अर्तुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. provoking, contentious,
quarrelsome.

अर्ति अर्ति, इस्, f. (a weakened form of आर्ति,
fr. rt. ऋ with आ), pain; the end of a bow.

आर्ति, इस्, f. painful occurrence, pain, injury, mischief,
evil; sickness; the end of a bow [cf. अर्ति and
आर्त्नी].
—आर्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or suffering
pain; (आन्), m., N. of a serpent.
—आर्ति-हन्, आ, आ, अ,
or आर्ति-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying pain.
—आर्त्य्-
अपहरण, अम्, n. the relieving of distress, pain, &c.

अर्तिका अर्तिका, f. an elder sister (in theatri-
cal language), [cf. अत्तिका and अन्तिका].
आर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, afflicted, pained. See s. v.

आर्त आर्त, अस्, आ, अम् (probably past pass.
part. of rt. ऋ with prep. आ, but according to some fr.
rt. ऋत्, and according to others an irreg. formation
fr. rt. अर्द्, which ought to form अर्ण with prep.
सम्, नि and वि, and अर्दित in other cases), struck
by calamity, afflicted, pained, disturbed; injured; op-
pressed, suffering, sick, unhappy.
—आर्त-गल, अस्,
m., N. of the plant Barleria Cærulea.
—आर्त-तर, अस्,
आ, अम्, extremely pained, disturbed, confounded.
—आर्त-ता, f. state of affliction, pain.
—आर्त-नाद
or आर्त-स्वर, अस्, m. a cry of pain.
—आर्त-बन्धु,
उस्, m. friend of the distressed.

आर्तपर्णि आर्तपर्णि, इस्, m. the son of Ṛta-
parṇa, a patronymic of Sudāsa.

आर्तभाग आर्तभाग, अस्, m. son of Ṛta-
bhāga, a patronymic of Jarat-kārava.

आर्तव आर्तव, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. ऋतु), be-
longing or conforming to the seasons or periods of
time, seasonable; menstrual, relating to or produced
by this discharge; (अस्), m. a section of the year, a
combination of several seasons; (ई), f. a mare; (अम्),
n. the menstrual discharge, certain days after the men-
strual discharge fit for generation; fluid discharged
by the female of an animal at the time of rut; a
flower.
आर्त्वेयी, f. a woman during her courses.

आर्त्नी आर्त्नी, f., Ved. the end of a bow, the
place where the string or sinew is fastened; (κορώνη)

आर्त्विजीन आर्त्विजीन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋत्विज्),
fit for the office of a priest.

आर्त्विज्य, अम्, n. the office or business of a sacri-
ficing priest, his rank or order.

आर्त्व्य आर्त्व्य, अस्, m. a patronymic of
Dvi-mūrdhan, a kind of Asura.
